`clever ssh --instance` now accepts a number from the list or `any`, as well as an instance ID. I haven't run it or the checks, because `node_modules` isn't installed here. `npm run docs` and `npm run validate` both failed (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, `eslint: command not found`). Once you've run `npm install`, run `npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate`.

- **`any`:** picks the lowest-numbered running instance.
- **Number:** a value such as `2` matches the instance with that number, which is the one the interactive prompt prints as "Instance 2". An ID still works the same way.
- **No match:** it fails with the existing "not a running instance" error.
- **Help text:** the option placeholder is now `<instance>` instead of `<instance-id>`, and the description lists the three forms.

I edited the docs by hand because `npm run docs` couldn't run. I changed the option row in `src/commands/ssh/ssh.docs.md` and the matching line in `skills/clever-tools/references/full-documentation.md`. The code change is in `src/commands/ssh/ssh.command.js`. When you regenerate the docs, check that they come out the same.

I only changed the `--instance` flag. The interactive prompt for choosing an instance is unchanged.
